scope: Autonomous S04-S11 assessment and F01 repair in the work branch; no main integration or installed-project upgrade

S01.title: Keep only the accepted full-context Jev inventory path
S01.preserved: Four stages, prompts, criteria, source offsets/attachments, batching, redaction, refusal behavior and completion manifest
S01.baseline_recovery: Read checkpoint_inventory.py from base_main; experimental worktrees retain their original implementation
S01.limitation: Fixed transport responses test orchestration, not model judgment or an accuracy improvement

S02.title: Make apply the only mandatory technical package application step
S02.changed: Foreground, background and Jev instructions plus CLI guidance use apply as the required save step; check remains an optional read-only preview
S02.preserved: Package checks before BEGIN and after BEGIN, source review, pinned guards, rollback, recovery, draft retention and background publication preconditions
S02.runtime_logic: Unchanged; complete Python ASTs match the S01 baseline after normalizing module documentation and the init message

validation.regression: 104 passed in full run; sole fixture setup failure corrected and rerun successfully

S02.limitation: Two synthetic pairs are a smoke comparison, not proof of accuracy or speed superiority. The candidate still chose optional check in one case. Both partial-scope sessions repaired missing source markers after a guard refusal; raw failures are retained. Native background app orchestration was not exercised.

S03.title: Own harmful-write probes in one doctor health path
S03.changed: Doctor delegates harmful-write behavior probes to its existing enforcement_health call; the duplicate probe loop, collection and unused import are removed
S03.preserved: Read/write-boundary enforcement health, all benign hook probes, six full selfchecks, configured command/timeout selection, native runtime differences and refusal behavior

validation.upgrade_from_S02_all_runtimes: passed; knowledge and selections preserved, second update idempotent

S03.limitation: Focused fixtures stub unrelated pinned-bundle health and full selfcheck execution; Linux hook probes run real subprocesses. Native Windows was not exercised; command selection and PowerShell invocation were simulated. No wall-time speed claim.

S04.title: Separate original-project preferences from generic memory
S04.changed: Remove unsupported Serena advice; make tracker report and score constraints opt-in through existing tracker data; use project-appropriate overview fields
S04.preserved: Tracker CLI, records, grading, streaks, weekly schedule, queue run discovery, canonical STATE shape and overview budgets; existing tracker projects retain their legacy score rule

validation.focused_integration: passed; generic PostgreSQL 3/5 STATE saved, tracker report absent without tracker, legacy routine retelling refused with tracker, tracker reads preserve bytes

S04.limitation: The historical routine score heuristic is retained for explicitly existing tracker projects; no tracker feature or data is removed.

S05.title: Collect resume context and watchdog notices through one entry point
S05.changed: Public resume wrapper reads supervision notices before rendering the existing memory pack; normal resume instructions have one command
S05.preserved: Idle and active warnings, read-only inbox/registration, other-turn prompt notices, old-clone fallback, unchanged pack_size and resume_pack budget calculation

validation.focused_integration: passed; absent watchdog creates no files, pending notice and degraded health visible in idle/active, corrupt inbox reported, notice bytes unchanged, pack-budget output identical

S05.limitation: Native user-systemd delivery is not exercised by the synthetic notice test.
S05.followup: Missing watchdog import now reports a read warning and still loads memory; tested by the structural selfcheck minimal clone.

S06.title: Give procedural rules one primary document owner
S06.changed: Package guide owns metadata/operations/stale retry/recovery details; checkpoint command explicitly loads it and retains concise execution safeguards; rule-owner map recorded
S06.preserved: All semantic inventory/draft review/source/unknown/drop rules, critical inline reminders, complete post-compaction anchor and legacy recon fields
S06.limitation: Two synthetic pairs do not establish model accuracy or speed superiority; repeated critical reminders and recon compatibility fields are retained.

S07.title: Provide a small interface for candidate shape validation
S07.changed: memory_formats owns existing navigation/format primitives and candidate shape orchestration; package calls one validator; structural CLI keeps compatibility aliases
S07.preserved: Exact validator function ASTs and error order, generic/legacy profile distinction, IDs/index/STATE/overview budgets, all baseline/staging/source/rollback checks remain with their existing owners
S07.limitation: The new module validates shape; it is not a semantic evidence checker or a replacement for any Git guard.
S07.followup: Structural selfcheck minimal tool clone includes memory_formats; distribution checks passed after correcting that dependency copy.

S08.title: Parse the decision graph through one consistent implementation
S08.changed: One snapshot parser owns supersession metadata, strict graph problems and diagnostic visibility; resolver and extract reuse parsed metadata and captured text
S08.preserved: Separate diagnostic warnings and authoritative refusal, full lineage, scoped interpretation instructions, historical labels, cycles/branches/duplicates/malformed handling, no persistent cache
S08.limitation: Warning-only views intentionally do not certify validity; the shared parser preserves that distinction. No semantic scope inference was added.

S09.title: Share update workflow across legacy and independent layouts

S10.title: Measure whether the legacy write-round heuristic is still useful
S10.decision: Removal rejected: package-only detection is zero, but direct supported memory edits still receive useful round feedback; Prime detects actual changed paths through a different lifecycle
S10.preserved: Original fail-open helper, manual flow, consultation gate, Prime transaction/lock/rollback and changed-file counter
S10.limitation: Synthetic hook protocols show capability and gaps; no claim about real-world turn frequency or runtime speed.

S11.title: Share identical hook policies while preserving native adapters
S11.decision: A new shared event catalog is rejected: all three adapters already call the same shared Python policies and shared command sources; their remaining registration/payload/lifecycle differences are real

evidence.claude: Edit/Write payload, sh shell, transcript message-based post-write counter
evidence.codex: apply_patch plus exec payloads; commandWindows branch and per-entry hook trust
evidence.prime: tool_call/tool_result lifecycle, filesystem-diff transaction validation, advisory mutation locks, turn/session reset and native prompt commands

S11.preserved: Three native adapters and their actual safeguards; no event bus, bridge subprocess or extra configuration introduced
S11.validation: Final all-runtime delivery, syntax and adapter selfchecks remain required.

preserved_priorities: All five first-stage priorities and phase-two P1/P2; experimental P3/P4/P5 remain separate

F01.title: Transaction selfcheck assumes STATE contains a Now section
F01.effect: Doctor or update can report a selfcheck failure for a valid STATE containing only Open
F01.scope: Outside S03; existing validation limitation, not introduced by deduplicating probes
F01.changed: Selfcheck initializes its own synthetic STATE before its disposable baseline commit; production transaction behavior and caller knowledge are unchanged
F01.validation: Public selfcheck succeeds for Open-only and 40-line STATE; caller bytes, HEAD and status remain unchanged
